segment.description: Stoney Creek, a Carter County mountain tributary (GNIS 01327124, HUC 06010103) draining the Holston Mountain slopes to the Watauga River near Hunter/Elizabethton; TWRA spring-stocked trout water.
segment.boundaries: Catalog covers the creek (workbook rows are undivided 'Stony Creek', Carter County). Temperature facts attribute to named stations: TDECWPC-STONY006.1CT (RM 6.1, Liberty Hollow Rd off SR 91), TDECWPC-STONY009.9CT (RM 9.9, upstream of the Watauga WTP), and USGS-03484200 'STONEY CREEK AT HUNTER, TN' (58.2 sq mi drainage, lower creek). IDENTITY NOTE: the wild-trout-list entry 'Little Stony Creek ... upstream of the confluence with Plot Branch (1.3 miles upstream of Hwy 321 crossing)' is a SEPARATE small stream near Hampton/SR-67 (TDECWPC-LSTON001.2CT at 36.3081,-82.0719; TDECWPC-FECO66D07), not the stocked Stoney Creek at Hunter/Elizabethton (TDECWPC-STONY000.3CT at 36.3706,-82.1556) - do not conflate the two.

coldSource.notes: Steep-gradient free-flowing mountain creek (catalog note); no dam, no spring influence claimed. Station identities verified via WQP Station metadata (USGS identity endpoint down this week).

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation of any kind found for Stoney Creek. Stocking is spring-only (see troutSpecies), and no survey of post-stocking persistence was located.

wildPopulation.detail: The stocked Stoney Creek does not appear on TWRA's wild-trout-streams list or special-regulation lists on the state's regulations publisher page. (Its namesake neighbor Little Stony Creek near Hampton IS on the wild-trout list - separate stream, see segment identity note.)

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Single-day summer grabs show genuinely cool water - 16.5 C at Hunter (July 1988) and 16.6-17.3 C on the upper creek (Aug 2001) - but stocking is spring-only, and nothing documents trout persisting past the stocking season.
